name: imaginecities-design-system
description: Machine-readable design system for **Imagine Cities** (Calgary nonprofit). Captures the brand as **DSDS** (Design System Documentation Schema, v0.15.2) documentation plus a **W3C DTCG** `tokens.json` of raw values, so AI tools and future codebases (the IC website) consume the brand consistently.

scripts.validate: npm run validate:schema && npm run validate:refs && npm run validate:tokens
scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm --prefix apps/assessment run build
